tasks.short: Signal other workers to weigh, move, or check products.

steps.what: Signal other workers to weigh or move products
Instruct other workers to check products

outputs: filed copy of signed instruction note v1

tasks.design: Signalling and instructing other workers to weigh, move, or check products stays with the weigher, in person. A job files the note in {DOCS} only after the weigher signs it. No job directs a worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: A message could move people before anyone had seen the goods.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be filed after the instruction is given.
tasks.still_hard: The signal depends on what the weigher sees in the moment.
tasks.altitude: The instruction stays. Filing the signed note shrinks.

reach.task: Move only on the weigher's instruction
reach.learn: That a filed note is not the signal

evidence.claim: The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not signal a worker.
Nothing is sent as an order before signature.
research_questions: How often the floor is too loud for a later written note to matter.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the signal step is the instruction itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every instruction is still given in person. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer rewritten. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.short: Compare labels, manifests, and orders to verify the shipment.

steps.what: Read product labels, tags, and tickets
Compare labels with shipping manifests and purchase orders
Verify weights, contents, and quality specifications

outputs: filed copy of signed shipment check v1

tasks.design: The weigher reads the product labels, tags, and tickets. A job in {ERP} compares those captured fields with the shipping manifest, the purchase order, and the bill of lading. The weigher verifies accuracy of contents, quality specifications, and weights, including every mismatch. They sign the check. A job files that version. A mismatch is not a rejection by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: A matching screen could accept a shipment nobody had looked at.
tasks.enabler_now: Captured fields can be compared with plain code.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the goods match the paper is still seen on the dock.
tasks.human_edge: The weigher verifies the shipment and signs the check.

ambition.what: Show a mismatch on the same shift the goods arrive, and sign the check before release.

tasks.altitude: The looking stays. Comparing captured fields shrinks.

evidence.claim: The records digest says matching a label, a manifest, and an order is plain code.
The records digest says one record can print the shipping documents, and a person still checks a field that does not match.

assumptions: The job does not accept a shipment.
Nothing is filed as verified before signature.
unknowns: Which document is the master for this shipment.
research_questions: How often a label cannot be read.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the read step is the looking itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the rate card or the required-field list when it changes, and clear rows the weigher will not sign.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every mismatch is still seen on the goods. The high end assumes only identical captured fields are no longer compared by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

role.altitude: The weigher spends the shift on the scale, the sample, and the check. A captured quantity can be filed after they sign it. The scale's own readout is not saved human time.
reach: A supervisor sees a shortage only from the note the weigher signed.
The laboratory receives the sample the weigher prepared, not a generated result.
skills_to_grow: Tell a scale readout from a quantity they are willing to sign.
Refuse a tally that names a worker as the cause of a defect.
role.ambitious_version: A signed quantity can be on the shipping record the same shift, and the weigher still signs it.
